title: Resident Benefits Schedule: Residency Deferral of the Respite Stay Advance
content:
| Guest's active Larkspur independent living residency began | Residency deferral |
|---|---|
| At least 36 whole months before the current date | 10 percent |
| Fewer than 36 whole months before the current date | 5 percent |
| No active residency | Nothing |

**Schedule entry.** For the advance on a booked stay under the Respite and Short-Term Stay Agreement, the residency deferral is ten percent for a guest whose active Larkspur independent living residency began at least thirty-six whole months before the current date, five percent for a guest whose active residency began fewer than thirty-six whole months before, and nothing for any other guest; the deferred part is paid with the final balance.

**What it defers.** The deferral is taken on the advance-nights charge — the advance nights times the nightly rate locked at booking — as it stands: the advance-nights charge is multiplied by 90 percent at 10 percent and by 95 percent at 5 percent. The part deferred is not collected in the advance; it is paid with the final balance of the stay.

**Records read.** The guest's Independent Living Residency Agreement in active status and its move-in date; whole months are counted from the move-in date to the current date.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical dates, current date 1 October 2026)

| Move-in date of the active residency | Whole months | Deferral |
|---|---|---|
| 1 October 2023 | 36 | 10 percent |
| 2 October 2023 | 35 | 5 percent |
| Residency vacated in 2025 | — | Nothing |

## Hypothetical illustration

An advance-nights charge of 1,673.00 for a resident of 40 whole months is 1,673.00 times 90 percent, that is 1,505.70 in the advance; the 167.30 deferred is paid with the final balance.
